patterns: APPSC asks one-line facts: light year = distance, most abundant element = hydrogen, Venus like Earth in size/mass, fastest planet Mercury, perihelion, blue moon = second full moon in a month, Steady State = Bondi & Gold.
APPSC dated current-affairs astronomy: total solar eclipse 22 July 2009, annular eclipse 15 Jan 2010, 2018 'blood moon', Blue Marble (Apollo 17).
Other PSCs repeat superlatives (largest, hottest, densest, no moons), Big Bang evidence (red shift, CMB), Chandrasekhar limit, comet tail away from Sun, eclipse geometry.
Moon-count and pre-2006 Pluto keys are time-sensitive traps; app correctly uses Saturn and 8 planets.
App adds many multi-statement and current-affairs items (Aditya-L1 data, 3I/ATLAS, SMILE, 2026 moon count) far beyond the simple PYQ style.
